Improve Your Snowboard Turns With This Simple Analogy (Beginner to Advanced Snowboarding Tips)

Struggling with your snowboard turns? Or just want to make your carving smoother and more controlled? In this video I break down a super simple analogy that will help you understand one of the most important skills in snowboarding: knee steering. This teaching tool works for absolute beginners learning their first linked turns and for advanced riders who want more precision, flow, and confidence on steeper terrain.

This analogy gives you a fresh way to feel how your knees guide the board, helping you:
✓ better initiate the edge change
✓ maintain better edge control
✓ achieve smoother edge changes in a carved turn
✓ ride with a more natural, intuitive style

Whether you're learning how to turn on a snowboard, improving your carving technique, or refining your all-mountain riding, this breakdown will make the movement clearer and easier to apply. It’s also a great complement to the other knee steering and snowboard technique videos linked below.
